name: llm-d-sc-complexity
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (BatchAllTripletLoss, 871 synthetic examples) for prompt-complexity-tier embeddings. Same 22.7M parameters; the 0.023 vs 0.0227 difference is safetensors float rounding. Recorded because the card prints a base-model row in the same accuracy table. Evidence is an 80-prompt holdout the author wrote himself and flags as a homelab result not independently reproduced. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-01-28.

benchmarks.name: Complexity-tier classification accuracy
benchmarks.config: Card '| Model | Accuracy | Macro F1 | Boundary cases |' table: this model 0.9750 vs 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (base, same anchors)' 0.6250 (x100). 80-prompt held-out set authored independently of training, 20 per tier, same anchors.json, cosine top-3-per-tier argmax. Card states homelab, not independently reproduced; 871 synthetic training examples.
